channel.title: Wildcard Watch: SAP
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving SAP, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch: SAP NetWeaver: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic
item.description:
SAP NetWeaver: exploited · check vendor

First step: Follow the vendor advisory for SAP NetWeaver: install the update or apply the mitigation it lists.

SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.

Medium · Check vendor · CVE-2025-42884

item.title: Patch now: Microsoft Patch Tuesday November 2026 patches 1093 vulnerabilities (63 Critical, 1029 Important, 1 Moderate)
item.description:
Microsoft (multiple products): fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for the affected Microsoft products. The CCB advisories list the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix. The same day the CCB also warned: Critical SAP Vulnerabilities Allow Remote Code Execution.

Critical · Fix available
